import re
src = open('appcfg/loader.py').read()
old = '''def _set_path(cfg: dict, keys: list[str], raw: str) -> None:
    node = cfg
    for k in keys[:-1]:
        node = node[k]
    leaf = keys[-1]
    node[leaf] = _coerce(raw, node.get(leaf))'''

    node = cfg
    for k in keys[:-1]:
        nxt = node.get(k)
        if not isinstance(nxt, dict):
            nxt = {}
            node[k] = nxt
        node = nxt
    leaf = keys[-1]
    node[leaf] = _coerce(raw, node.get(leaf))'''
assert old in src
open('appcfg/loader.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
EOF
